channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Rajpal Yadav trolled for dancing to Salman Khan's song at niece's pre-wedding after getting bail in Rs 9 crore cheque bounce case
item.description: Rajpal Yadav was released from Tihar Jail on interim bail, 12 days after surrendering in a cheque-bounce case. Soon after his release, he was seen dancing at his niece's wedding. He also thanked fans on Instagram for their support during his financial troubles.

item.title: Nifty 50 Q3 profits dip after 13 quarters despite 10 pc revenue growth
item.description: Excluding banks, financial services and oil and gas firms, aggregate revenue rose 10 per cent in the quarter — the first double‑digit increase since the March 2023 quarter but aggregate profits dipped due to one‑time accounting impact of India's new Labour Codes.

item.title: Sealed borders push Dawood Syndicate to ramp up local drug production
item.description: Tightened security along the India-Pakistan border, especially in Punjab and along the LoC, has disrupted traditional drug smuggling routes used by Pakistan-based cartels. As a result, the D-Company (Dawood Syndicate) has shifted focus to large-scale local drug manufacturing within India.

item.title: Stones thrown at Vande Bharat Express in UP; Mohan Bhagwat on board, window cracked
item.description: The stone-pelting took place at approximately 3:20 PM when the train was headed towards Delhi. According to railway sources, at least one stone struck the window of coach C4, resulting in a visible crack in the glass.

item.title: Prohibitory orders imposed in Karnataka's Bagalkot after stone pelting during Shivaji Jayanti procession
item.description: Prohibitory orders were imposed in Bagalkot, Karnataka, after stone-pelting during a Shivaji Jayanti procession near Killa Oni as it passed a mosque, triggering tension. Authorities invoked Section 163 of the BNSS, banning gatherings of over four people and restricting protests and weapons

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open in red; IT continues to bleed
item.description: As of 9.26 a.m., Sensex lost 154 points, or 0.19 per cent, to reach 82,343, and Nifty dipped 31 points, or 0.12 per cent, to settle at 25,423.

item.title: US commander says 20,000 soldiers, 12,000 policemen planned for Gaza
item.description: At the inaugural Board of Peace meeting launched by Donald Trump in Davos, nine countries — Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, the UAE, Morocco, Bahrain, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Uzbekistan and Kuwait — pledged $7 billion for Gaza relief, well below the estimated $70 billion needed for reconstruction.

item.title: Hey Balwanth movie review: Audience say film fails to engage as a whole
item.description: Director Gopi Atchara's Telugu movie Hey Balwanth starring Suhas Pagolu and Shivani Nagaram, has received positive review and decent ratings from the audience around the world.

item.title: Rana Daggubati on eating saltless food for months, returning advances, not being the 'hot guy' anymore
item.description: Rana Daggubati remembers how his perception of life changed from being the "hot guy" to just "survival skills".

item.title: Narco-terror route exposed: Foreign pistols seized, infiltration bid foiled on LoC in Rajouri
item.description: Security forces in Rajouri busted a suspected narco-terror link after arresting a Nowshera youth with two foreign-made pistols allegedly supplied by Pakistan-based handlers. The breakthrough comes amid heightened vigilance along the Line of Control, where the Army also foiled an infiltration attempt in the Sunderbani sector
